holdings.name: ICICI Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Net profit for the quarter ended June 2026 stood at Rs 16,276 crore compared to Rs 14,456 crore in June 2025.
The bank scheduled its media and analyst calls for October 17, 2026 to discuss Q2 and half-year financial results.

expected.text: Nomura expects 17% core PPOP growth for preferred private banks, including ICICI Bank, in Q2.

holdings.why_it_matters: ICICI Bank is the fund's largest position at 7.73% weight. Its 3-month return of -4.93% generated an estimated contribution of -0.381%, compounding declines in the 38.2% Financials allocation.

watch.text: Earnings announcement and analyst briefings scheduled for October 17, 2026.

holdings.name: Axis Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Provisional updates reported advances of ₹13,846 billion and deposits of ₹14,521 billion as of September 30, 2026.
Senior management official Sanjeev Moghe submitted his resignation, effective October 30, 2026.
Net profit for the June 2026 quarter reached Rs 7,670 crore, compared to Rs 6,279 crore in June 2025.

holdings.why_it_matters: Axis Bank is the second-largest holding at 6.40% weight. It recorded a -5.03% return over 3 months, aligning with broader weakness across large-cap banking peers.

watch.text: Q2 FY27 earnings conference call scheduled for October 17, 2026.

holdings.name: Bharti Airtel Ltd

what_changed.text: Airtel launched refreshed postpaid plans featuring bundled annual international roaming and unveiled enterprise platform IQ Gateway.
The Department of Telecommunications issued multiple monetary penalties for subscriber verification non-compliances.

expected.text: Analysts project the postpaid plan refresh could generate a 2% uplift in blended mobile ARPU.

watch.text: Competitive and valuation effects stemming from the upcoming Reliance Jio IPO valuation process.

holdings.name: State Bank of India

what_changed.text: SBI reported June 2026 net profit of Rs 25,121 crore, up from Rs 22,121 crore in June 2025.
The bank acquired nearly 40% of Reliance Industries' $1.35 billion debt issuance.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 5.41% fund weight, SBI declined -9.26% over 3 months, delivering an estimated contribution of -0.501% and acting as one of the primary drags on portfolio performance.

watch.text: Outcomes and updates from institutional investor interactions following its September 2026 meetings.

holdings.name: HDFC Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Provisional data showed September 2026 advances of ₹33,075 billion and deposits of ₹33,275 billion.
The board appointed Anup Bagchi as Managing Director and CEO for a three-year term starting October 27, 2026.
Jigar Shah was named General Counsel from October 1, 2026 after Sudhir Kumar Jha superannuated.

expected.text: Nomura forecasts 17% core PPOP growth in Q2 across preferred lenders including HDFC Bank.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 4.76% weight, HDFC Bank's -13.82% quarterly loss was the fund's biggest detractor, reducing portfolio returns by an estimated -0.658%.

watch.text: Executive leadership transition on October 27, 2026 and Q2 financial results.

holdings.name: Kotak Mahindra Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Reported provisional Q2 FY27 net advances of Rs 5,77,094 crore and deposits of Rs 6,51,491 crore.
RBI granted approval for Anup Kumar Saha to take over as MD & CEO for three years starting January 1, 2027.
Approved the merger of subsidiary Kotak Mahindra Investments Limited into Kotak Alternate Asset Managers Limited.

expected.text: Nomura expects 17% core PPOP growth in Q2 across selected private banks including Kotak Mahindra Bank.

holdings.why_it_matters: Kotak Bank is a 4.57% weight and was the fund's highest positive contributor over 3 months, gaining 15.27% and adding an estimated +0.698% to partially offset other bank declines.

watch.text: Board meeting on October 24, 2026 to review and approve Q2 and H1 FY27 unaudited results.

holdings.name: TVS Motor Company Ltd

what_changed.text: September 2026 monthly sales grew 24% to 672,790 units, contributing to a 27% increase in Q2 sales.
Net profit for the June 2026 quarter expanded to Rs 1,058 crore from Rs 643 crore in June 2025.
Public reports emerged detailing disagreements and succession discussions within the TVS family promoter group.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 3.99% weight, the stock advanced 7.16% over 3 months, delivering an estimated contribution of +0.286% within the 18% Consumer Discretionary sector.

watch.text: Developments concerning the family memorandum of understanding and business division discussions.

holdings.name: Craftsman Automation Ltd

what_changed.text: Quarterly net profit rose to Rs 151 crore on revenue of Rs 2,432 crore in June 2026, compared to Rs 70 crore in June 2025.
Formed step-down German subsidiary Craftsman Fronberg Precision GmbH with EUR 25,000 capital in late August 2026.
Received a GST demand order on September 30, 2026 for Rs 68.72 lakh plus interest and equivalent penalty.

holdings.why_it_matters: Craftsman Automation holds a 3.96% weight. Its 15.99% 3-month return provided an estimated +0.633% contribution, representing the fund's second-largest positive performance driver.

watch.text: Operations and commercial traction at German subsidiary Craftsman Fronberg Precision GmbH.

holdings.name: Larsen & Toubro Ltd

what_changed.text: Secured LNTP for the 2x800 MW Chandrapura thermal power project and secured mega EPC transmission orders across Saudi Arabia, UAE, and India.
Promoted four personnel to senior management positions effective July 1, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: L&T represents 3.64% of the fund and anchors the 10.5% Industrials allocation. A -7.66% decline over 3 months added to fund underperformance.

watch.text: Execution milestones and conversion of new domestic and Middle Eastern power transmission contracts.

holdings.name: Infosys Ltd

what_changed.text: Infosys stated that the U.S. Department of Labor suspension of the PERM program will cause no material operational impact.
Announced an AI research partnership with Columbia University and extended IT modernization work with ABN AMRO via Infosys Topaz.

holdings.why_it_matters: Infosys carries a 3.56% weight in the portfolio. Its -7.49% 3-month return and -32.67% 1-year drop have been an ongoing drag on the fund's Technology bucket.

watch.text: Regulatory shifts and developments concerning U.S. PERM labor certification processing.

portfolio.statement: The fund dropped -4.86% over the past 3 months, led downward by heavy losses in top banking and IT holdings despite double-digit gains in select auto and industrial names.
interp: Financials, representing 38.2% of the fund, exhibited deep internal divergence as sharp declines in HDFC Bank, SBI, and ICICI Bank surpassed the rally in Kotak Mahindra Bank.
Consumer Discretionary and Industrial mid-to-large-cap holdings including Craftsman Automation and TVS Motor served as the fund's main positive counterweights.
portfolio.line: Losses across large private and state banks outweighed automotive and engineering gains over the quarter.

drivers.text: HDFC Bank fell 13.82% over 3 months, detracting an estimated 0.658% from fund return amid selling pressure and leadership change announcements.
Kotak Mahindra Bank rose 15.27% over 3 months, adding an estimated 0.698% following CEO approval and solid provisional quarterly business updates.
State Bank of India slipped 9.26% over 3 months, contributing an estimated -0.501% to fund performance as banking stocks retreated.
Craftsman Automation gained 15.99% over 3 months, contributing an estimated 0.633% supported by continued operating growth.

Approved MD and CEO appointments at both HDFC Bank and Kotak Mahindra Bank.
